test_title: PYST 5: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 1).
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘B is the brother of A’

‘A – B’ means ‘B is the sister of A’

‘A % B’ means ‘B is the daughter of A’

‘A & B’ means ‘B is the wife of A’

If A & B % C + D – E, then how is E related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 %
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Sister
 Daughter
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: A & B % C + D – E

It means: B is the wife of A, C is the daughter of B, D is the brother of C, E is the sister of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f51d0d7284e25a9c2773e487cc621deea9a0074f38424b8fe1cf3b59b1027df1.png] 

Here, E is the 'Daughter' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
